phases.text: 3 min, walk 90s, 5 min, walk 2.5, 3 min, walk 90s, 5 min
3×/wk after runs + Fri post-climb: 5×5 bodyweight (or +5 lb), 2 in reserve
5×5 weighted, +2.5–5 lb each week; Sunday max set
3×3 heavy + 3×3 archer each side; max test week 10
Volume at flash level, open-hand only, no crimps, 3 sessions
2 limit sessions on finger-friendly styles + 1–2 volume
1 V8 session, 1 purple session, 1 volume, LES 4th if the finger is quiet

programs.name: Vital → V8
programs.goal: Back to purples by week 6, V8 attempts by week 8.
rows: Volume only at flash level: 30–40 problems a session, open-hand, zero crimps. Get the PIP finger looked at by a hand PT in week 1. 3 sessions; no 4th until the finger has been checked.
Two limit sessions a week (slopers, pinches, compression, dynos first; crimps last), one or two volume sessions. Add the Thursday LES session for style variety. Finger check-in end of week 4 and 7.
One dedicated V8 session, one purple session, one volume session; LES Thursday for volume only. If the finger flares, drop back a phase — that's the plan working, not failing.

programs.name: Pull-ups → 10+ / weighted
programs.goal: 10 clean, or +20 lb × 5, by week 10. One-arm is a 12-month goal; archers in weeks 8–10 are its first step.
rows: 5×5 bodyweight after each run (Tue, Sun) and after Friday climbing. Two reps in reserve on every set. If you're under 10 now, grease the groove instead: 4 sets of 5 spread through non-climb days.
5×5 weighted starting +10 lb, +2.5–5 lb a week. Sunday max set unweighted, logged.
3×3 heavy, then 3×3 archer pull-ups each side as skill work. Retest max reps on the Sunday of week 10.

programs.name: Couch to 5K (two runs a week)
programs.goal: A comfortable 25–30 min continuous run by week 10. The standard plan wants 3 runs a week; at 2 you'll land around week 7–8 of it, which is the point where it stops feeling like intervals.
rows: The one run that always happens. Start 20 min, +5 min a week.
Take it on weeks the finger wants a wall-free day. Skip it on weeks you add the 4th climb.
Follow the C25K bars on the calendar; each week's intervals are in the bar tooltip and the table below.

programs.name: Badminton
programs.goal: Twice a month at Kotofit's Saturday beginner open play. It's the fun one — no progression, no tracking.
